parameters.name: shelf_width
parameters.description: Dimensions are in millimeters. Multiple shelves can fit side-by-side on the grid if your Shelf Width is an odd multiple of 28mm, such as 112mm or 196mm.

parameters.name: snap_type
parameters.description: openGrid snap type for connecting to base plates.

parameters.name: snap_fitment
parameters.description: The fitment affects the tightness of the snap when mounted (ease of removing the peg) Use a value between 0.0 and 1.0, with 0.5 meaning a standard fit. A value between 0.66-0.75 would be a tight fit, and a value of 1.0 would be very difficult to insert and remove.
